en: The postcard depicts a monochrome photograph of a wide, straight city street lined with ornate late-19th-century or early-20th-century stone buildings with mansard roofs and many architectural details. A small number of people, including children, are seen on the sidewalks, suggesting an early 20th-century European urban setting. On the corner building to the right, there is a prominent bakery sign 'Bäckerei Max Beegen' in German, with 'Bäcke' also visible on the shop window.
